machine_class: Debian 13 (trixie) x86_64, Dell OptiPlex Micro 7010, Intel Core i5-13500T (20 threads), 15 GiB RAM

measurement.workload: loopback fixture, synthetic owner session, one server process tree; the Python reference runs the same workload

margin: RSS budget is 3.2x the calibrated maximum; health and dashboard latency budgets are about 7.9x and 6.4x the calibrated maxima. The bound catches a gross regression (leak, blocked request, runaway polling), not runner noise.
scope: The Rust server process tree only, measured by tools/measure-product.py; it excludes helper collectors, Redis and any owner-host service. Latency is loopback with no TLS or VPN relay.
